outcome_summary: Starved after mandatory strength-potion retrieval stalled
improvements: The bot no longer treats optional food as a permanent reason to block descent. Uncollected food still remains unfinished, while strength potions, upgrade scrolls, and needed keys retain their pickup requirements.
incoming_learnings: Separate valuable pickup priorities from mandatory progression. Inspect the actual veto targets rather than trusting its upgrade/strength wording. Keep optional hazard-room food unfinished and logged when descent is otherwise admitted; never infer collection, relax fire safety, or guess potion effects. This isolated gate repair does not establish puzzle success or future survival.

review.review: The run ended in confirmed starvation: decision 3903's accepted wait reduced HP from 1 to 0, and the public terminal message explicitly reports starvation (log lines 11150–11151). The initiating dead end appeared after the awareness well revealed a potion of strength at cell 999 (decision 2826, line 8000). At decision 2827, recorded diagnostics show this mandatory target outside current paths, with trapped or locked component boundaries and no general threat or inventory veto (line 8002). Descent was refused, then fallback drank the waterskin and subsequently spent advancing turns waiting, interrupted by other actions. Complete source inspection resolves an important ambiguity: tools/priority_resources.py already offers guarded puzzle preparation when ordinary pickup is unavailable; this is not simply a missing call. Independent hunger, staging, protected-trip, and potion-protection requirements remain. No patch is supplied because no validated alternative establishes all required admissions at the initiating state. Reduced snapshot probes are not recovered runtime memory and cannot certify a replacement. The original full suite passed 1540 tests, with four skipped; no new regression or baseline-red/candidate-green comparison is claimed.
review.learnings: Distinguish a genuine mandatory strength target from optional food. Inspect recorded route boundaries and preparation admissions before changing selection. A supply fallback already exists; the next investigation needs an offline, recorded-input-validated state and a safe staging, protected-trip, and potion-protection fixture. Do not waive progression pickup, guess potion effects, or shorten waiting and call the problem solved.
